record.reason: The study probes adaptive transformer depth on synthetic CLUTRR family-relation chains (2–10 hops) using single-token answers. It analyzes layer use rather than proposing an early-exit/dynamic-depth method; no latency/compute savings are measured. The adaptive-inference connection is weak.
record.title: Do Transformers Use their Depth Adaptively? Evidence from a Relational Reasoning Task
